source.stem:
Some children were asked to choose their favourite type of pet.
The pie chart shows the results.

parts.text: 41 children chose Cat. Work out how many children were asked altogether. [2]
Work out how many children chose Hamster. [2]

hinge.title: When choosing or making a display for several time series, decide whether a line graph communicates the comparison more clearly than many clustered bars.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Clustered column graph is the label that belongs on this item, so 'When choosing or making a display for several time series, decide' is answered as clustered column graph rather than line graph.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: line graph still holds here even though Use a sensible scale that fits the values and still allows comparisons between series is missing from the stem — on the item about When choosing or making a display for several time.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: The answer is line graph because of the most obvious label, colour, size or printed number in the stem, without using 'When choosing or making a display for several time series, decide' as the operative test.

intelligence.enrichment: For several measurements recorded over ordered times, a line graph can show change and comparison across the order without the crowding that many clustered bars can create.
